full_judgment: 13. So far possession is concerned the Plaintiff has claimed his possession and the PW 2 and PW3 has supported his possession. The Defendant claimed possession in the suit land. It appears from the exhibit-Kha that the recent Khatian has been prepared in the name of the Defendant. This exhibit-Kha has got its presumptive value of correctness unless the contrary is proved. The Plaintiff did not adduce any single piece of evidence against the preparation of the recent record. So it appears to me that the presumptive value of the exhibit-Kha has remained unshaken and goes against the Plaintiff. On perusal of the judgments of both the Courts below it appears to me that the learned Assistant Judge has discussed and considered the evidence on record properly and has come to a correct decision in deciding the question in controversy. Admittedly the Plaintiff having failed to institute the suit within 3 years after attaining 21 of his age the suit is held to be barred by limitation. Section 3 of the Limitation Act provides for dismissal of a suit if filed beyond the period of limitation. Admittedly the suit having filed beyond the prescribed period of limitation there is no other alternative but to dismiss the suit as barred by limitation. From the facts and circumstances and discussion made above, I find, that the learned Sub-ordinate Judge committed an error of law resulting in an error in the decision occasioning a failure of justice in passing the impugned judgment and decree. I find merit in the Rule.
